Services

More than lessons

Alongside teaching, I prepare the materials that make study stick — for students, and for the teachers and parents supporting them.

One-to-one online classes

Live lessons on Google Meet, paced to the student — not to a class average. Concepts first, then board-style practice.

  • Matric, FSc, O & A Level maths
  • University statistics & SPSS
  • English and Urdu

Group batches

One fixed slot a week for a small batch at the same level. The same teaching, shared cost — ideal for exam classes.

  • 8–10 students per batch
  • Fixed weekly timetable
  • Monthly fee per student

Mock tests

Board-pattern papers with marking schemes and worked solutions, so students meet the real exam before the real exam.

  • Full papers & chapter tests
  • Marking schemes included
  • Single papers or full sets

Ready-made, chapter-by-chapter slide decks and notes. Teachers save preparation hours; students get clean revision material.

Homework help

Homework checked and explained — not just marked. Students learn where they went wrong, in language they understand.

Questions
Before you ask

    

      
Where do lessons happen?
Online, one-to-one on Google Meet. You need a phone, tablet or laptop and an internet connection — nothing else.

      
Which boards and levels are covered?
Matric (Class 9–10), FSc / Intermediate, Cambridge O & A Levels, entry-test mathematics, and university statistics including SPSS and data analysis.

      
Can lessons be in Urdu?
Yes — teaching is in English, Urdu, or a mix of both, whichever helps the student learn fastest. This is especially popular with diaspora families abroad.

      
How do I book?
By email only — use the booking form above and send it to leaderoftime786@gmail.com. Timings and the confirmed fee are agreed by email before the first paid lesson.

      
How do I pay?
By JazzCash, Easypaisa or bank transfer, agreed in writing before the first paid lesson. Standard hourly rates (60-minute class): Matric Rs 1,500 / $15, FSc and O Level Rs 2,000 / $20, A Level and entry tests Rs 2,500 / $25, university statistics & SPSS Rs 3,000 / $30. Shorter classes are pro-rata; 4 days a week is 5% off monthly, 5 days is 10% off.

      
What do mock tests and materials include?
Mock papers follow the board pattern and come with marking schemes and worked solutions (Rs 300–500 per paper). Study packs start at $5, up to $15. Slide decks are priced on enquiry, per chapter or as bundles.

      
I am a teacher — can I buy materials for my class?
Yes. Slide decks, chapter notes and mock papers are prepared for teachers as well as students, and can be reused in your own teaching.
